meals.name: Scrambled eggs with tomato and rye bread
meals.pl: Jajecznica z pomidorem i chlebem razowym
meals.desc: Soft scrambled eggs with fresh tomato and two slices of rye bread. Quick, filling and good for a busy morning.
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Dice the tomato and soften it in the oil over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently until just set.
Serve with the bread.

meals.name: Quark with raspberries and walnuts
meals.desc: A high-protein bowl of Polish quark with tart raspberries and crunchy walnuts. No cooking needed.
steps: Thaw the raspberries in the fridge overnight or for 2 minutes in the microwave.
Loosen the quark with a spoon of water if it is very dry.
Top with the raspberries and chopped walnuts.

meals.name: Oats with skyr and banana
meals.desc: Creamy porridge cooked in milk, topped with skyr for extra protein and a sliced banana.
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk for 4 minutes, stirring now and then.
Let it cool for a minute so the skyr stays cold and creamy.
Top with the skyr and sliced banana.

meals.name: Spinach and feta omelette
meals.desc: A fluffy omelette folded around wilted spinach and salty feta, with a slice of rye bread.
steps: Wilt the spinach in the oil in a non-stick pan for 1 minute.
Pour in the beaten eggs and tilt the pan to spread them.
Crumble the feta over one half, cook until set, then fold.
Serve with the bread.

meals.name: Open sandwiches with quark and radish
meals.desc: A classic Polish breakfast: rye bread spread with quark, topped with radish and chives.
steps: Mix the quark with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Spread it on the bread.
Top with sliced radish and chopped chives.

meals.name: Chicken, rice and broccoli
meals.desc: The meal-prep classic: seared chicken breast, fluffy rice and steamed broccoli.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook it in 150 ml of water for 12 minutes, then rest it covered.
Slice the chicken, season with salt, pepper and paprika.
Sear it in the oil for 6 to 7 minutes until cooked through.
Steam the broccoli florets for 4 minutes and serve everything together.

meals.name: Turkey chili with beans
meals.desc: A lean, smoky chili with ground turkey, kidney beans and peppers. Even better the next day.
steps: Soften the diced onion and garlic in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the turkey and brown it, breaking it up.
Stir in the diced pepper, tomatoes, drained beans, paprika and cumin.
Simmer for 20 minutes and season to taste.

meals.name: Wholegrain pasta with tuna and tomato
meals.pl: Makaron razowy z tuńczykiem i pomidorami
meals.desc: A pantry-friendly pasta with a quick garlic and tomato sauce, tuna and fresh rocket.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Warm the sliced garlic in the olive oil, add the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes.
Fold in the drained tuna and the pasta.
Finish with rocket.

meals.name: Baked salmon with buckwheat and broccoli
meals.desc: Oven-baked salmon with lemon, nutty buckwheat groats and broccoli. Rich in omega-3.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Season the salmon, squeeze over the lemon and bake for 12 minutes.
Cook the buckwheat in twice its volume of water for 15 minutes.
Steam the broccoli and serve together.

meals.name: Chicken and feta salad
meals.desc: A crunchy salad with grilled chicken, feta, cucumber and tomato, with rye bread on the side.
steps: Season and pan-fry the chicken for 6 minutes, then slice it.
Chop the cucumber and tomato.
Toss everything with the leaves, crumbled feta and olive oil.
Serve with the bread.

meals.name: Tomato soup with rice and turkey meatballs
meals.pl: Zupa pomidorowa z ryżem i klopsikami
meals.desc: A lighter take on Polish pomidorowa with small turkey meatballs and rice.
steps: Simmer the grated carrot, onion and tomatoes in 400 ml of water for 15 minutes.
Roll the seasoned turkey into small meatballs.
Drop them into the soup and cook for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice separately and serve the soup over it.

meals.name: Roast chicken with potatoes and slaw
meals.desc: Roast chicken and potato wedges with a fresh cabbage and carrot slaw in yoghurt.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Toss the potato wedges in the oil and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the seasoned chicken and roast for 20 minutes more.
Shred the cabbage and carrot and mix with the yoghurt and salt.

meals.name: Shakshuka with feta
meals.desc: Eggs gently poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce, topped with feta.
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, paprika and cumin and simmer for 10 minutes.
Make three wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 6 minutes.
Crumble over the feta and serve with the bread.

meals.name: Cod with potatoes and green beans
meals.desc: Pan-fried cod in a little butter with lemon, boiled potatoes and green beans.
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 18 minutes.
Cook the green beans for 6 minutes.
Pan-fry the cod in the butter for 3 minutes per side.
Squeeze over the lemon and serve.

meals.name: Chicken wrap with yoghurt sauce
meals.pl: Tortilla z kurczakiem i sosem jogurtowym
meals.desc: A wholewheat wrap with chicken, crisp vegetables and a garlicky yoghurt sauce.
steps: Pan-fry the sliced chicken in the oil for 6 minutes.
Mix the yoghurt with salt and a little garlic.
Fill the tortilla with the sauce, vegetables and chicken.
Roll it up tightly and cut in half.

meals.name: Beef stir-fry with rice
meals.desc: Thin strips of beef and mixed vegetables in soy sauce, served with rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Stir-fry the thin beef strips in the hot oil for 2 minutes and set aside.
Stir-fry the frozen vegetables for 5 minutes.
Return the beef, add the soy sauce and toss for 1 minute.

meals.name: Zucchini fritters with yoghurt
meals.desc: Crisp zucchini fritters served with cool natural yoghurt.
steps: Grate the zucchini, salt it and squeeze out the water after 5 minutes.
Mix with the eggs and flour.
Fry small fritters in the oil for 3 minutes per side.
Serve with the yoghurt.

meals.name: Turkey goulash with pearl barley
meals.pl: Gulasz z indyka z kaszą jęczmienną
meals.desc: A paprika-rich turkey and pepper goulash served on pearl barley.
steps: Brown the diced turkey with the onion in the oil.
Add the pepper, tomatoes and sweet paprika.
Simmer covered for 25 minutes.
Cook the barley and serve the goulash over it.

meals.name: Red lentil and pumpkin soup
meals.pl: Krem z dyni i czerwonej soczewicy
meals.desc: A velvety, naturally sweet soup with red lentils, topped with pumpkin seeds.
steps: Dice the pumpkin and onion.
Simmer them with the lentils in 500 ml of water for 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth and season.
Top with pumpkin seeds and serve with the bread.

meals.name: Skyr with apple
meals.desc: A cold, high-protein snack with crisp apple.
steps: Dice the apple.
Stir it into the skyr, with cinnamon if you like.

meals.name: Cottage cheese with tomato and chives
meals.pl: Serek wiejski z pomidorem i szczypiorkiem
meals.desc: Polish serek wiejski with juicy tomato and chives.
steps: Dice the tomato.
Mix with the cottage cheese and chopped chives, then season with pepper.

meals.name: Hummus with carrot and pepper sticks
meals.desc: Crunchy vegetable sticks with creamy hummus.
steps: Cut the carrot and pepper into sticks.
Serve with the hummus for dipping.

meals.name: Turkey ham sandwich
meals.desc: Rye bread with lean turkey ham and cucumber.
steps: Layer the ham and sliced cucumber on the bread.

meals.name: Kefir with almonds
meals.desc: A glass of kefir with a handful of almonds.
steps: Pour the kefir and serve the almonds alongside.

meals.name: Two boiled eggs with tomato
meals.desc: Simple, satisfying and easy to prepare ahead.
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, then cool them in cold water.
Peel, halve and serve with the sliced tomato.

meals.name: Peanut butter banana oats
meals.pl: Owsianka z masłem orzechowym i bananem
meals.desc: Warm oats cooked in milk with a spoon of peanut butter and sliced banana.
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk for 4 minutes.
Stir in the peanut butter.
Top with the sliced banana.

meals.name: Protein porridge with berries
meals.desc: Oats cooked in water and milk, then stirred with vanilla whey and topped with warm berries.
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk and 100 ml of water for 4 minutes.
Take off the heat and stir in the protein powder.
Warm the berries for a minute and spoon them over.

meals.name: Apple cinnamon porridge with walnuts
meals.pl: Owsianka z jabłkiem, cynamonem i orzechami
meals.desc: Grated apple cooked into the oats with cinnamon, finished with walnuts and skyr.
steps: Grate the apple into the milk with the oats and a pinch of cinnamon.
Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring.
Top with the skyr and chopped walnuts.

meals.name: Chocolate protein oats
meals.desc: Cocoa porridge with whey and raspberries. Tastes like dessert, eats like a proper breakfast.
steps: Simmer the oats and cocoa in the milk for 4 minutes.
Stir in the protein powder off the heat.
Top with the raspberries.

meals.name: Overnight oats with skyr and blueberries
meals.pl: Owsianka na noc ze skyrem i borówkami
meals.desc: Mix it the night before and breakfast is waiting in the fridge.
steps: Stir the oats, skyr, milk and chia together in a jar.
Cover and chill overnight.
Top with the blueberries in the morning.

meals.name: Mango coconut overnight oats
meals.pl: Owsianka na noc z mango i kokosem
meals.desc: Oats soaked in light coconut milk and Greek yoghurt with sweet mango.
steps: Mix the oats, coconut milk and yoghurt.
Fold in the mango.
Chill overnight.

meals.name: Millet porridge with apple and raisins
meals.desc: A Polish favorite: creamy millet cooked in milk with apple, raisins and cinnamon.
steps: Rinse the millet with boiling water.
Simmer it in the milk for 15 minutes with the grated apple and raisins.
Top with sliced almonds and cinnamon.

meals.name: Chia pudding with mango
meals.desc: Chia seeds set overnight in soy drink, layered with Greek yoghurt and mango.
steps: Stir the chia into the soy drink and chill for at least 4 hours.
Layer with the yoghurt and mango.

meals.name: Skyr bowl with berries and seeds
meals.desc: Thick Icelandic skyr with mixed berries, pumpkin seeds and a drizzle of honey.
steps: Thaw the berries for 2 minutes in the microwave.
Spoon over the skyr with the seeds and honey.

meals.name: Greek yoghurt with kiwi and almonds
meals.pl: Jogurt grecki z kiwi i migdałami
meals.desc: Creamy Greek yoghurt with sliced kiwi, almonds and a few oats for crunch.
steps: Slice the kiwi.
Top the yoghurt with kiwi, almonds and oats.

meals.name: Sweet quark with honey and pear
meals.desc: Low-fat quark whipped with honey and topped with pear and walnuts.
steps: Whip the quark with the yoghurt and honey until smooth.
Top with diced pear and walnuts.

meals.name: Chive quark spread on rye
meals.desc: Polish twarożek with chives and radish, piled on rye bread with cucumber.
steps: Mash the quark with the sour cream, salt and chopped chives.
Spread on the bread.
Serve with sliced radish and cucumber.

meals.name: Avocado toast with poached eggs
meals.pl: Tost z awokado i jajkiem w koszulce
meals.desc: Wholemeal toast with smashed avocado, lemon and two soft poached eggs.
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and salt and spread it on.
Poach the eggs in simmering water for 3 minutes.
Top the toast with the eggs and serve with tomatoes.

meals.name: Scrambled eggs with smoked salmon
meals.desc: Soft eggs folded with smoked salmon and dill on rye bread.
steps: Melt the butter and gently cook the beaten eggs.
When almost set, fold in the salmon and dill.
Serve on the bread.

meals.name: Scrambled eggs with chives and ham
meals.desc: A Polish weekend classic with turkey ham, chives and a wholemeal roll.
steps: Fry the chopped ham in the butter for a minute.
Add the eggs and stir until just set.
Scatter with chives and serve with the roll.

meals.name: Mushroom and cheese omelette
meals.desc: Golden mushrooms and melted gouda in a three-egg omelette.
steps: Fry the sliced mushrooms in the oil until golden.
Pour in the beaten eggs.
Add the cheese, cook until set and fold.

meals.name: Egg white omelette with spinach and tomato
meals.desc: One whole egg plus cottage cheese for a light, protein-packed omelette with toast.
steps: Beat the eggs with the cottage cheese.
Wilt the spinach in the oil, pour in the eggs and cook until set.
Serve with the tomatoes and toast.

meals.name: Vegetable frittata
meals.desc: Oven-baked eggs with pepper, zucchini and feta. Cut into wedges and keeps for 3 days.
steps: Heat the oven to 190 °C.
Soften the diced pepper and zucchini in the oil in an ovenproof pan.
Pour over the beaten eggs and crumble on the feta.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until set.

meals.name: Egg muffins with ham and pepper
meals.desc: Grab-and-go egg cups baked in a muffin tin. Make a batch for the week.
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C.
Beat the eggs and stir in the chopped ham, pepper and cheese.
Pour into a greased muffin tin and bake for 18 minutes.

meals.name: Green shakshuka
meals.desc: Eggs baked in garlicky spinach and leek with feta and a slice of rye.
steps: Soften the sliced leek in the oil.
Add the spinach and cook until thawed and hot.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 6 minutes.
Crumble over the feta and serve with bread.

meals.name: Pancakes with sweet quark
meals.desc: Thin Polish naleśniki filled with lightly sweetened quark and raspberries.
steps: Whisk the flour, milk and egg into a thin batter.
Fry thin pancakes in a lightly oiled pan.
Mix the quark with the honey.
Fill, roll up and serve with the raspberries.

meals.name: Banana protein pancakes
meals.desc: Fluffy little pancakes made from banana, eggs, oats and whey, with Greek yoghurt.
steps: Blend the banana, eggs, oats and protein powder.
Fry small pancakes in the oil for 2 minutes per side.
Serve with the yoghurt.

meals.name: Apple racuchy with skyr
meals.desc: Lighter Polish apple fritters made with kefir and wholemeal flour.
steps: Mix the flour, kefir and egg into a thick batter.
Fold in the thinly sliced apple.
Fry spoonfuls in the oil for 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Serve with the skyr and cinnamon.

meals.name: Quark pancakes (serniczki)
meals.desc: Soft cheesecake-like pancakes made mostly from quark, served with strawberries.
steps: Mash the quark with the egg and flour.
Shape small pancakes and fry for 3 minutes per side.
Serve with the sliced strawberries.

meals.name: French toast with berries
meals.desc: Eggy cinnamon toast with warm berries and Greek yoghurt.
steps: Whisk the eggs and milk with cinnamon.
Soak the bread and fry in the butter until golden.
Top with the warmed berries and yoghurt.

meals.name: Egg and chive sandwiches
meals.desc: Classic Polish pasta jajeczna: chopped egg with yoghurt and chives on rye.
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes and cool them.
Chop finely and mix with the yoghurt, salt, pepper and chives.
Spread on the bread and top with radish.

meals.name: Smoked mackerel spread on rye
meals.desc: Smoky mackerel mashed with quark, pickle and onion on dark rye bread.
steps: Remove the skin and bones from the mackerel.
Mash it with the quark.
Stir in the diced pickle and onion.
Spread on the bread.

meals.name: Hummus toast with egg
meals.desc: Wholemeal toast with hummus, a jammy egg and cucumber.
steps: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, then cool and halve.
Toast the bread and spread with hummus.
Top with egg and cucumber.

meals.name: Ricotta and tomato toast
meals.desc: Creamy ricotta, cherry tomatoes and a drizzle of olive oil on toast.
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with ricotta.
Top with halved tomatoes, rocket, olive oil and pepper.

meals.name: Roll with quark and strawberries
meals.desc: A wholemeal roll spread with sweet quark and fresh strawberries.
steps: Halve the roll.
Mix the quark with the honey and spread it on.
Top with sliced strawberries.

meals.name: Flatbread with smoked salmon and egg
meals.desc: Icelandic rye flatbread with butter, smoked salmon and sliced egg.
steps: Boil the egg for 9 minutes and slice it.
Butter the flatbreads thinly.
Top with salmon, egg and cucumber.

meals.name: Icelandic oat porridge with skyr
meals.desc: Iceland’s everyday porridge cooked in water with raisins, served with cold skyr.
steps: Simmer the oats in 250 ml water with a pinch of salt for 4 minutes.
Stir in the raisins.
Serve with the skyr and a splash of cold milk.

meals.name: Skyr smoothie bowl
meals.desc: Thick blended skyr and berries topped with banana, oats and seeds.
steps: Blend the skyr with the frozen berries until thick.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with sliced banana, oats and seeds.

meals.name: Green protein smoothie
meals.desc: Kale, banana, kiwi and whey blended with soy drink. Drinkable breakfast in five minutes.
steps: Put everything in a blender with a few ice cubes.
Blend until smooth.

meals.name: Strawberry kefir smoothie
meals.desc: A Polish summer classic: strawberries blended with kefir and oats.
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Drink right away.

meals.name: Buckwheat breakfast bowl with egg
meals.pl: Kasza gryczana z jajkiem i kefirem
meals.desc: A savory Polish breakfast: buckwheat with a fried egg, dill and a glass of kefir.
steps: Cook the buckwheat in twice its volume of salted water for 15 minutes.
Fry the eggs in the oil.
Serve the buckwheat with the eggs, dill and kefir.

meals.name: Quinoa breakfast bowl with apple
meals.desc: Quinoa simmered in milk with cinnamon, apple and almonds.
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in the milk for 15 minutes.
Stir in the diced apple and cinnamon.
Top with the almonds.

meals.name: Tofu scramble with spinach
meals.desc: A vegan take on jajecznica: crumbled tofu with turmeric, spinach and tomato on toast.
steps: Crumble the tofu into the hot oil with turmeric, salt and pepper.
Cook for 4 minutes.
Add the spinach and diced tomato and cook for 2 minutes.
Serve on the toast.

meals.name: Beans on toast with egg
meals.desc: White beans simmered in passata with smoked paprika, on toast with a fried egg.
steps: Simmer the beans in the passata with smoked paprika for 8 minutes.
Fry the egg in the oil.
Spoon the beans onto toast and top with the egg.

meals.name: Cottage cheese, egg and veg plate
meals.pl: Talerz z serkiem wiejskim, jajkiem i warzywami
meals.desc: A Polish-style breakfast plate: cottage cheese, a boiled egg and crunchy vegetables.
steps: Boil the egg for 9 minutes.
Cut the vegetables into sticks.
Plate everything with the bread.

meals.name: Smoked salmon and cream cheese roll
meals.desc: A wholemeal roll with light cream cheese, smoked salmon, cucumber and dill.
steps: Halve the roll and spread with the cream cheese.
Layer on the salmon, cucumber and dill.

meals.name: Breakfast wrap with egg and beans
meals.desc: Scrambled eggs, black beans and salsa-style tomato rolled in a wholewheat tortilla.
steps: Scramble the eggs in the oil.
Warm the beans with chili flakes.
Fill the tortilla with eggs, beans, diced tomato and cheese, then roll.

meals.name: Savory millet with feta and tomato
meals.desc: Fluffy millet with cherry tomatoes, spinach and crumbled feta.
steps: Cook the millet in salted water for 15 minutes.
Stir through the spinach so it wilts.
Top with halved tomatoes, feta and olive oil.

meals.name: Baked oatmeal with blueberries
meals.desc: Oats, egg and milk baked with blueberries until golden. Slice and reheat all week.
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C.
Mix the oats, milk, egg, honey and cinnamon.
Fold in the blueberries and pour into a small dish.
Bake for 25 minutes.

meals.name: Kefir oats with apple
meals.desc: Oats softened in kefir with grated apple and pumpkin seeds. No cooking needed.
steps: Stir the oats into the kefir and leave for 10 minutes or overnight.
Grate in the apple and top with the seeds.

meals.name: Savory cottage cheese bowl
meals.desc: Cottage cheese with cucumber, cherry tomatoes, seeds and a rice cake on the side.
steps: Dice the cucumber and halve the tomatoes.
Top the cottage cheese with vegetables and seeds.
Serve with the rice cakes.

meals.name: Halloumi and tomato sandwich
meals.desc: Grilled halloumi with tomato and rocket in a wholemeal pitta.
steps: Slice the halloumi and dry-fry for 2 minutes per side.
Warm the pitta and open it up.
Fill with halloumi, tomato and rocket.

meals.name: Light full breakfast
meals.desc: Eggs, mushrooms, beans and tomato with a slice of toast, without the heavy fry-up.
steps: Fry the mushrooms and halved tomato in the oil.
Warm the beans in the passata.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Serve with the toast.

meals.name: Mushroom and cheese toast
meals.desc: A mini zapiekanka: toast topped with mushrooms and melted gouda.
steps: Fry the mushrooms in the oil until golden.
Pile onto the bread, top with cheese.
Grill or bake at 220 °C until melted.
Scatter with chives.

meals.name: Savory oats with egg and spinach
meals.desc: Oats cooked in broth-style water with spinach, parmesan and a soft egg.
steps: Cook the oats in 250 ml salted water for 4 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and parmesan.
Top with a fried or poached egg.

meals.name: Strawberry quark bowl
meals.desc: Polish quark whipped smooth with yoghurt, topped with strawberries and almonds.
steps: Whip the quark with the yoghurt.
Top with sliced strawberries and almonds.

meals.name: Turkey and avocado sandwich
meals.desc: Wholemeal toast with turkey ham, avocado and tomato.
steps: Toast the bread if you like.
Layer the avocado, ham and tomato.
Season with pepper.

meals.name: Skyr with mango and chia
meals.desc: Thick skyr with thawed mango and a sprinkle of chia.
steps: Thaw the mango for a minute in the microwave.
Spoon over the skyr and sprinkle with chia.

meals.name: Bircher muesli
meals.desc: Swiss-style soaked oats with grated apple, yoghurt, raisins and hazelnut crunch from walnuts.
steps: Mix the oats, yoghurt and milk and soak overnight.
Grate in the apple in the morning.
Top with raisins and walnuts.

meals.name: Chicken curry with rice
meals.desc: Chicken and peppers in a light coconut red curry, served with rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the onion and curry paste for 2 minutes.
Add the diced chicken and pepper and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.

meals.name: Chicken teriyaki bowl
meals.desc: Sticky soy, honey and ginger chicken with rice, broccoli and sesame.
steps: Cook the rice and steam the broccoli.
Brown the diced chicken in a dry non-stick pan for 6 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, honey and grated ginger and reduce until sticky.
Serve over rice with broccoli and sesame.

meals.name: Roast chicken thighs with sweet potato
meals.desc: One tray: paprika chicken thighs roasted with sweet potato and red onion.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Toss the chicken, sweet potato wedges and onion with oil, paprika and salt.
Roast for 30 minutes, turning once.
Serve with spinach leaves.

meals.name: Chicken fajitas
meals.desc: Spiced chicken and peppers in warm tortillas with yoghurt and lime.
steps: Slice the chicken, peppers and onion.
Stir-fry with cumin, paprika and chili for 8 minutes.
Squeeze over the lime.
Serve in warm tortillas with yoghurt.

meals.name: Pesto chicken pasta
meals.desc: Wholegrain pasta tossed with basil pesto, chicken and cherry tomatoes.
steps: Cook the pasta.
Pan-fry the sliced chicken for 6 minutes.
Toss the pasta with the pesto, chicken and halved tomatoes.
Fold in the rocket.

meals.name: Lemon chicken couscous
meals.desc: Fluffy couscous with lemon chicken, cucumber, tomato and parsley.
steps: Pour 90 ml of boiling water over the couscous and cover for 5 minutes.
Pan-fry the chicken with lemon zest.
Chop the vegetables and parsley.
Mix everything with lemon juice and olive oil.

meals.name: Chicken satay noodles
meals.desc: Rice noodles with chicken and crunchy vegetables in a peanut, soy and lime sauce.
steps: Soak or boil the noodles as the pack says.
Stir-fry the chicken and vegetables for 7 minutes.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy, lime and 3 tbsp hot water.
Toss everything together with chili flakes.

meals.name: Oven-baked chicken schnitzel with potatoes
meals.pl: Pieczony kotlet z kurczaka z ziemniakami
meals.desc: Crispy breaded chicken baked instead of fried, with potatoes and cucumber salad.
steps: Heat the oven to 210 °C.
Flatten the chicken, dip in beaten egg then breadcrumbs.
Brush with oil and bake for 18 minutes.
Boil the potatoes. Slice the cucumber into the yoghurt with salt and dill.

meals.name: Chicken gyros salad
meals.desc: Gyros-spiced chicken with cabbage, pepper, pickles and a garlic yoghurt dressing. A Polish party favorite made lighter.
steps: Season the chicken strips with gyros spice and fry in the oil.
Shred the cabbage and dice the pepper and pickles.
Mix the yoghurt with garlic and salt.
Layer or toss everything together.

meals.name: Chicken souvlaki pitta
meals.desc: Lemon and oregano chicken in a warm pitta with tomato, onion and tzatziki.
steps: Marinate the chicken in lemon, oregano and salt for 10 minutes.
Grill or pan-fry for 7 minutes.
Grate the cucumber into the yoghurt.
Stuff the warm pitta.

meals.name: Chicken and vegetable soup
meals.desc: A lighter rosół: clear chicken broth with carrot, leek, celery, noodles and dill.
steps: Simmer the chicken with the vegetables in 700 ml water for 35 minutes.
Shred the chicken.
Cook the noodles separately.
Serve the broth over the noodles with dill.

meals.name: Light chicken caesar salad
meals.desc: Crisp leaves, chicken, parmesan and toast croutons in a yoghurt caesar dressing.
steps: Pan-fry the chicken and slice it.
Toast and cube the bread.
Mix the yoghurt with lemon, garlic and half the parmesan.
Toss everything and top with the rest of the parmesan.

meals.name: Chicken quinoa power bowl
meals.desc: Quinoa with chicken, roasted sweet potato, spinach and hummus.
steps: Roast the sweet potato cubes in the oil at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes.
Pan-fry the chicken.
Build the bowl and add the hummus.

meals.name: Chicken paprikash with buckwheat
meals.pl: Kurczak w sosie paprykowym z kaszą
meals.desc: Tender chicken in a creamy paprika and pepper sauce over buckwheat.
steps: Brown the diced chicken and onion in the oil.
Add the pepper, tomatoes and sweet paprika and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream off the heat.
Serve with the buckwheat.

meals.name: Sweet and sour chicken
meals.desc: A lighter takeaway classic with pepper, onion and pineapple-free tangy sauce, over rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Stir-fry the chicken pieces, then the pepper and onion.
Mix the tomato purée, honey, soy and a splash of vinegar and water.
Toss to coat and simmer for 2 minutes.

meals.name: Chicken thighs with dill potatoes
meals.pl: Udka z młodymi ziemniakami i koperkiem
meals.desc: Crisp-skinned style thigh fillets with dill potatoes and cucumber in sour cream (mizeria).
steps: Boil the potatoes and toss with dill.
Season and pan-fry the thighs for 6 minutes per side.
Slice the cucumber and mix with the sour cream and salt.

meals.name: Turkey meatballs in tomato sauce
meals.pl: Klopsiki z indyka w sosie pomidorowym
meals.desc: Soft turkey meatballs simmered in passata, served with buckwheat.
steps: Mix the turkey with grated onion, salt and pepper and roll into balls.
Simmer them in the passata for 15 minutes.
Cook the buckwheat.
Serve topped with parsley.

meals.name: Turkey burger with slaw
meals.desc: A juicy turkey patty in a wholemeal roll with crunchy cabbage slaw.
steps: Shape the seasoned turkey into a patty and fry for 5 minutes per side.
Shred the cabbage and carrot and mix with the yoghurt.
Build the burger with tomato and slaw.

meals.name: Turkey and green bean stir-fry
meals.desc: Quick garlic and soy turkey strips with green beans and brown rice.
steps: Cook the brown rice.
Stir-fry the turkey strips with garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the green beans and soy and cook for 5 minutes more.

meals.name: Turkey and zucchini lasagne
meals.desc: Zucchini slices layered with turkey ragù and mozzarella instead of pasta.
steps: Heat the oven to 190 °C.
Brown the turkey and onion, add the passata and simmer for 10 minutes.
Layer thin zucchini slices with the sauce.
Top with mozzarella and bake for 30 minutes.

meals.name: Turkey and lentil curry
meals.desc: A hearty curry with turkey, red lentils, tomato and spinach.
steps: Fry the onion and curry paste in the oil.
Add the diced turkey and brown it.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and 200 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach.

meals.name: Turkey hummus wrap
meals.desc: Turkey ham, hummus, spinach and pepper rolled in a wholewheat tortilla.
steps: Spread the hummus over the tortilla.
Layer the ham, spinach and pepper strips.
Roll tightly and halve.

meals.name: Turkey patties with barley and beetroot
meals.pl: Kotlety z indyka z kaszą i buraczkami
meals.desc: Polish-style mielone patties with pearl barley and warm grated beetroot.
steps: Mix the turkey with the egg, salt and pepper and shape 3 patties.
Fry for 5 minutes per side.
Cook the barley.
Grate the beetroot and warm it with a little lemon juice.

meals.name: Beef chili con carne
meals.desc: Lean beef, kidney beans, corn and peppers in a smoky tomato sauce with rice.
steps: Brown the beef in a dry pan.
Add the pepper, tomatoes, beans, corn, cumin and chili.
Simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve over rice.

meals.name: Spaghetti bolognese
meals.desc: A rich lean beef and vegetable ragù with spaghetti and parmesan.
steps: Brown the beef with the diced onion and carrot.
Add the passata and simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti.
Serve with parmesan.

meals.name: Beef goulash with potatoes
meals.desc: Slow-simmered beef with onion, pepper and sweet paprika. Worth the wait.
steps: Brown the diced beef in the oil.
Add the onion, pepper, paprika, tomato purée and 400 ml water.
Cover and simmer for 75 minutes.
Serve with boiled potatoes.

meals.name: Beef burger with sweet potato fries
meals.pl: Burger wołowy z frytkami z batatów
meals.desc: A lean beef burger with cheese and oven sweet potato fries.
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C and roast the sweet potato fries in the oil for 25 minutes.
Shape and fry the burger for 4 minutes per side, adding the cheese at the end.
Build the burger.

meals.name: Beef and broccoli
meals.desc: Takeaway-style beef strips with broccoli in soy, garlic and ginger.
steps: Cook the rice.
Sear the beef strips in a hot pan for 2 minutes and remove.
Stir-fry the broccoli with garlic and ginger, adding a splash of water.
Return the beef, add the soy and toss.

meals.name: Beef tacos
meals.desc: Spiced beef with lettuce, tomato, cheese and yoghurt in tortillas.
steps: Brown the beef with cumin, paprika and chili.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beef, lettuce, tomato, cheese and yoghurt.

meals.name: Steak salad
meals.desc: Seared rump steak sliced over rocket with cherry tomatoes, parmesan and potatoes.
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Sear the seasoned steak for 3 minutes per side and rest it.
Slice and serve over rocket and tomatoes with olive oil and parmesan.

meals.name: Beef roulades with buckwheat
meals.desc: Thin beef rolled around pickle and onion, braised until tender. A Silesian Sunday dish.
steps: Pound the beef thin, season and roll it around strips of pickle and onion.
Brown the rolls in the oil.
Add 300 ml water, cover and simmer for 75 minutes.
Serve with buckwheat and beetroot.

meals.name: Roast pork loin with potatoes and cabbage
meals.pl: Schab pieczony z ziemniakami i surówką
meals.desc: Garlic and marjoram roast pork loin with potatoes and white cabbage salad.
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C.
Rub the pork with garlic, marjoram and salt and roast for 45 minutes.
Boil the potatoes.
Shred the cabbage and carrot with lemon and olive oil.

meals.name: Pork with braised sauerkraut
meals.desc: Pan-seared pork loin with sauerkraut braised with onion and caraway.
steps: Braise the sauerkraut with the onion, caraway and 100 ml water for 25 minutes.
Boil the potatoes.
Sear the pork steaks for 4 minutes per side.

meals.name: Pork tenderloin with apples
meals.desc: Tender pork medallions with caramelized apples, onion and millet.
steps: Cook the millet.
Sear the pork medallions in the oil for 3 minutes per side.
In the same pan, cook the onion and apple wedges in the butter until golden.
Serve together.

meals.name: Pork and vegetable noodles
meals.desc: Lean pork strips with stir-fry vegetables, rice noodles and soy.
steps: Prepare the noodles.
Stir-fry the pork for 3 minutes.
Add the vegetables and ginger and cook for 5 minutes.
Toss with noodles and soy.

meals.name: Bigos (hunter’s stew)
meals.desc: Poland’s national stew of sauerkraut, cabbage, pork, sausage and mushrooms. Better on day two.
steps: Brown the diced pork and sausage.
Add both cabbages, mushrooms, tomato purée, bay leaf and allspice with 200 ml water.
Simmer covered for 75 minutes.
Serve with the bread.

meals.name: Polish baked beans with sausage
meals.desc: White beans in tomato with a little smoked sausage and marjoram.
steps: Fry the diced sausage and onion.
Add the beans, passata and marjoram.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with bread.

meals.name: Żurek with egg and sausage
meals.desc: Sour rye soup with potatoes, a little sausage and a halved boiled egg.
steps: Simmer the diced potatoes and sausage in 500 ml water with żurek starter (or a spoon of sourdough starter) for 20 minutes.
Boil the egg.
Stir in the sour cream and marjoram.
Serve with the halved egg and bread.

meals.name: Sauerkraut soup with pork
meals.desc: A warming sour cabbage soup with pork, carrot and potatoes.
steps: Simmer the diced pork in 600 ml water for 15 minutes.
Add the sauerkraut, carrot, onion and potatoes.
Cook for 25 minutes and season with pepper and marjoram.

meals.name: Lazy cabbage rolls
meals.desc: All the flavor of gołąbki without the rolling: turkey, rice and cabbage baked in tomato.
steps: Brown the turkey and onion.
Add the shredded cabbage and cook until soft.
Stir in the rice, passata and 200 ml water.
Simmer covered for 25 minutes.

meals.name: Icelandic lamb with potatoes
meals.desc: Herb-rubbed lamb leg steaks with potatoes, carrots and a little gravy, Sunday-style.
steps: Rub the lamb with thyme, garlic and salt.
Boil the potatoes and carrots.
Pan-fry the lamb for 4 minutes per side and rest it.
Warm the peas and serve.

meals.name: Icelandic lamb soup
meals.desc: Kjötsúpa: Iceland’s comforting lamb and root vegetable soup with oats.
steps: Simmer the lamb in 800 ml water for 30 minutes, skimming.
Add the diced vegetables and oats.
Cook for 20 minutes more and season.

meals.name: Lamb kofta with couscous
meals.desc: Spiced lamb skewers with couscous, cucumber and a mint yoghurt.
steps: Mince or finely chop the lamb and mix with cumin, chili and salt.
Shape onto skewers and grill for 10 minutes.
Soak the couscous in 90 ml boiling water.
Serve with the vegetables and yoghurt.

meals.name: Chicken, kale and apple salad
meals.pl: Sałatka z kurczakiem, jarmużem i jabłkiem
meals.desc: Massaged kale with chicken, apple, walnuts and a mustard dressing.
steps: Massage the kale with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Pan-fry and slice the chicken.
Toss with apple slices, walnuts and olive oil mixed with mustard.

meals.name: Chicken and broccoli pasta bake
meals.pl: Zapiekanka makaronowa z kurczakiem i brokułem
meals.desc: Wholegrain pasta baked with chicken, broccoli and a light cheese sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Cook the pasta and broccoli together.
Fry the chicken pieces.
Mix everything with the milk and half the cheese, top with the rest and bake for 15 minutes.

meals.name: Cajun chicken with rice and beans
meals.pl: Kurczak cajun z ryżem i fasolą
meals.desc: Smoky cajun-spiced chicken with rice, kidney beans and corn.
steps: Cook the rice.
Rub the chicken with cajun spice and pan-fry for 7 minutes.
Warm the beans, corn and diced pepper in the same pan.
Serve together.

meals.name: Turkey and lentil soup
meals.desc: A thick soup of red lentils, turkey, carrot and cumin with a squeeze of lemon.
steps: Simmer the diced turkey, lentils, carrot and onion in 600 ml water with cumin for 25 minutes.
Season and finish with lemon and parsley.

meals.name: Lemon chicken orzo-style rice soup
meals.pl: Zupa cytrynowa z kurczakiem i ryżem
meals.desc: Greek-inspired avgolemono: chicken and rice in a silky lemon and egg broth.
steps: Simmer the chicken and rice in 600 ml water for 18 minutes, then shred the chicken.
Whisk the egg with the lemon juice and a ladle of hot broth.
Stir it back in off the heat until silky.
Finish with dill.

meals.name: Chicken tikka with cauliflower rice
meals.pl: Kurczak tikka z ryżem z kalafiora
meals.desc: Yoghurt-marinated spiced chicken with grated cauliflower “rice” and a little basmati.
steps: Marinate the chicken in yoghurt, garam masala, chili and garlic.
Grill or bake at 220 °C for 15 minutes.
Grate the cauliflower and stir-fry for 5 minutes with the cooked rice.
Serve with sliced red onion.

meals.name: Quick beef pho
meals.desc: Thin beef in a ginger-spiced broth with rice noodles, lime and herbs.
steps: Simmer 600 ml water with the ginger, onion, star anise and soy for 15 minutes.
Cook the noodles.
Slice the beef paper-thin.
Pour the boiling broth over the noodles and beef, then finish with lime and herbs.

meals.name: Chicken kebab bowl
meals.desc: Spiced chicken over bulgur with cabbage, tomato, cucumber and garlic yoghurt.
steps: Cook the bulgur for 12 minutes.
Season the chicken with kebab spice and fry for 10 minutes.
Shred the cabbage and dice the vegetables.
Build the bowl and spoon over the garlic yoghurt.

meals.name: Teriyaki salmon with rice
meals.desc: Glazed salmon with rice and garlicky green beans.
steps: Cook the rice and the green beans.
Bake the salmon at 200 °C for 10 minutes.
Simmer the soy and honey for 1 minute and brush it over.
Sprinkle with sesame.

meals.name: Salmon poke bowl
meals.desc: Rice topped with salmon, avocado, cucumber, edamame-style peas and soy dressing.
steps: Cook the rice and let it cool slightly.
Bake or pan-fry the salmon and flake it.
Arrange with avocado, cucumber and thawed peas.
Drizzle with soy and sesame.

meals.name: Salmon with dill potatoes and asparagus beans
meals.desc: Oven salmon with dill potatoes and a cucumber and yoghurt salad.
steps: Boil the potatoes and toss with dill.
Bake the salmon at 200 °C for 12 minutes with lemon.
Slice the cucumber into the yoghurt.

meals.name: Creamy salmon and spinach pasta
meals.desc: Wholegrain pasta in a light cream cheese sauce with salmon and spinach.
steps: Cook the pasta, saving a cup of the water.
Pan-fry the salmon cubes for 4 minutes.
Stir in the cream cheese, spinach and a splash of pasta water.
Toss with the pasta and lemon.

meals.name: Baked cod with Mediterranean vegetables
meals.desc: Cod baked on a tray of zucchini, pepper, tomato and olives with couscous.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Roast the chopped vegetables and olives in the oil for 15 minutes.
Add the cod and bake for 12 minutes more.
Serve with couscous soaked in boiling water.

meals.name: Cod and coconut curry
meals.pl: Curry z dorszem i mleczkiem kokosowym
meals.desc: Flaky cod in a fragrant light coconut curry with spinach and rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the curry paste for a minute, add the coconut milk and 100 ml water.
Add the cod chunks and simmer for 6 minutes.
Stir in the spinach.

meals.name: Fish Greek style
meals.desc: Polish Christmas favorite: fried cod under a sweet-sour carrot and tomato sauce.
steps: Pan-fry the floured cod in half the oil.
Grate the carrot and soften with the onion in the rest of the oil.
Add the tomato purée, allspice and a splash of water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Spoon over the fish and serve with potatoes.

meals.name: Plokkfiskur (Icelandic fish stew)
meals.desc: Iceland’s home-cooking classic: haddock and potatoes mashed in a light white sauce, with rye bread.
steps: Boil the potatoes and poach the haddock for 6 minutes.
Soften the onion in the butter, then add the milk and simmer.
Flake in the fish and roughly mash in the potatoes.
Season with plenty of pepper and serve with flatbread.

meals.name: Baked haddock with potatoes
meals.desc: Haddock baked with lemon and butter, boiled potatoes and green peas.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Bake the haddock with butter, lemon and salt for 12 minutes.
Boil the potatoes and peas.

meals.name: Arctic char with barley and greens
meals.desc: Pan-seared Arctic char with pearl barley, kale and lemon.
steps: Cook the barley.
Sear the char skin-side down for 4 minutes, then 1 minute on the other side.
Wilt the kale in the same pan.
Serve with lemon.

meals.name: Garlic prawn spaghetti
meals.desc: Spaghetti with prawns, garlic, chili, cherry tomatoes and parsley.
steps: Cook the spaghetti.
Warm the garlic and chili in the olive oil.
Add the prawns and halved tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and parsley.

meals.name: Prawn stir-fry with noodles
meals.desc: Fast prawn and vegetable stir-fry with ginger, soy and rice noodles.
steps: Prepare the noodles.
Stir-fry the vegetables and ginger for 4 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes.
Toss with noodles and soy.

meals.name: Thai prawn curry
meals.desc: Prawns and vegetables in a red coconut curry with lime and rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the curry paste, add coconut milk and the vegetables and simmer for 6 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes.
Finish with lime.

meals.name: Tuna and white bean salad
meals.pl: Sałatka z tuńczykiem i białą fasolą
meals.desc: Tuna, white beans, red onion, tomato and parsley with lemon and olive oil.
steps: Drain the tuna and beans.
Toss with the sliced onion, halved tomatoes and parsley.
Dress with lemon and olive oil.

meals.name: Tuna salad wrap
meals.desc: Tuna mixed with yoghurt, corn and pepper in a wholewheat tortilla.
steps: Mix the tuna with the yoghurt, corn and diced pepper.
Spread over the tortilla with the lettuce.
Roll up tightly.

meals.name: Tuna pasta salad
meals.desc: The Polish lunchbox staple: pasta, tuna, corn, pickles and peas in a light yoghurt dressing.
steps: Cook the pasta and peas and cool them under cold water.
Mix in the tuna, corn and diced pickles.
Stir through the yoghurt with salt and pepper.

meals.name: Tuna patties with salad
meals.desc: Crisp tuna and potato patties with a leafy salad and yoghurt dip.
steps: Boil and mash the potatoes.
Mix with tuna, egg, salt and dill and shape 4 patties.
Fry for 3 minutes per side.
Serve with salad and yoghurt.

meals.name: Herring with potatoes and onion
meals.desc: Matjes herring with boiled potatoes, red onion and a dollop of yoghurt with dill.
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Slice the herring and onion.
Serve with the yoghurt mixed with dill.

meals.name: Smoked mackerel and beetroot salad
meals.desc: Smoky mackerel with beetroot, apple, leaves and horseradish yoghurt.
steps: Flake the mackerel.
Dice the beetroot and apple.
Toss with the leaves.
Top with yoghurt mixed with horseradish.

meals.name: Sardines on toast with tomato
meals.desc: Sardines in tomato sauce on wholemeal toast with rocket and lemon.
steps: Toast the bread.
Top with the sardines and their sauce.
Finish with rocket, lemon and pepper.

meals.name: Smoked salmon and potato salad
meals.pl: Sałatka z łososiem wędzonym i ziemniakami
meals.desc: Warm new potatoes with smoked salmon, cucumber, dill and a mustard yoghurt dressing.
steps: Boil the potatoes and halve them.
Mix the yoghurt with mustard and dill.
Toss with the cucumber and leaves.
Top with the salmon.

meals.name: Red lentil dal with rice
meals.desc: Creamy spiced red lentils with tomato and spinach over rice.
steps: Fry the onion, ginger, garlic, cumin and turmeric in the oil.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and 400 ml water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the spinach.
Serve with rice.

meals.name: Chickpea and spinach curry
meals.desc: Chickpeas in a coconut tomato curry with spinach and rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the curry paste, add the tomatoes, coconut milk and chickpeas.
Simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the spinach.

meals.name: Chickpea Greek salad
meals.desc: Chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, red onion, olives and feta with oregano.
steps: Chop the vegetables.
Toss with the chickpeas and olives.
Top with feta, oregano and olive oil.

meals.name: Baked falafel pitta
meals.desc: Oven-baked chickpea falafel in a pitta with salad and hummus.
steps: Blitz the chickpeas, parsley, onion, cumin and salt.
Shape small balls, brush with oil and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Fill the pitta with salad, hummus and falafel.

meals.name: Crispy tofu stir-fry
meals.desc: Golden tofu cubes with vegetables, soy and ginger over rice.
steps: Press and cube the tofu, then fry in the oil until golden.
Stir-fry the vegetables and ginger.
Add the tofu and soy.
Serve over rice.

meals.name: Tofu and vegetable green curry
meals.desc: Tofu, zucchini and green beans in a light coconut curry.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the curry paste, add the coconut milk and vegetables.
Add the cubed tofu and simmer for 8 minutes.

meals.name: Quinoa tabbouleh with feta
meals.desc: Quinoa with masses of parsley, tomato, cucumber, lemon and feta.
steps: Cook the quinoa and let it cool.
Chop the parsley, tomato and cucumber.
Mix with lemon and olive oil.
Top with crumbled feta.

meals.name: Roasted veg buddha bowl
meals.desc: Quinoa with roasted sweet potato and chickpeas, kale and tahini-style hummus dressing.
steps: Roast the sweet potato and chickpeas with oil and paprika at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Cook the quinoa.
Massage the kale with a pinch of salt.
Build the bowl and thin the hummus with water as a dressing.

meals.name: Lecsó with egg
meals.desc: Peppers, zucchini and onion stewed in tomato with eggs and a slice of bread.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil.
Add the peppers, zucchini, tomatoes and paprika and simmer for 15 minutes.
Crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 6 minutes.
Serve with bread.

meals.name: Pierogi ruskie with onion and salad
meals.pl: Pierogi ruskie z cebulką i surówką
meals.desc: Store-bought potato and cheese pierogi with golden onion and a carrot salad.
steps: Boil the pierogi until they float, plus 2 minutes.
Fry the sliced onion in the oil until golden and spoon over.
Grate the carrot and apple with a squeeze of lemon.

meals.name: Gnocchi with spinach and feta
meals.desc: Pan-fried gnocchi tossed with garlicky spinach, cherry tomatoes and feta.
steps: Fry the gnocchi in the oil until golden.
Add the garlic, spinach and tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes.
Crumble over the feta.

meals.name: Tomato and ricotta pasta
meals.desc: Spaghetti in a quick passata sauce with dollops of ricotta and basil.
steps: Cook the spaghetti.
Simmer the passata with garlic and olive oil for 8 minutes.
Toss with the pasta.
Top with ricotta and parmesan.

meals.name: Pesto pasta with green beans and potato
meals.pl: Makaron z pesto, fasolką i ziemniakiem
meals.desc: Genoa-style pasta with green beans, potato and pesto.
steps: Cook the diced potato for 5 minutes, add the pasta and cook until done, adding the beans for the last 5 minutes.
Drain and toss with the pesto.
Top with parmesan.

meals.name: Mushroom barley risotto
meals.desc: Polish kaszotto: pearl barley cooked like risotto with mushrooms and parmesan.
steps: Fry the onion and mushrooms in the butter until golden.
Add the barley and stir.
Add hot water a ladle at a time for 25 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan.

meals.name: Tomato and chickpea soup
meals.desc: A smoky tomato soup with chickpeas and a swirl of yoghurt.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil with smoked paprika.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and 300 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend half of it for body.
Serve with yoghurt and bread.

meals.name: Krupnik barley soup
meals.desc: Traditional barley soup with vegetables and chicken.
steps: Simmer the chicken in 700 ml water for 15 minutes.
Add the barley and vegetables and cook for 25 minutes.
Shred the chicken back in and add parsley.

meals.name: Ukrainian borscht with beans
meals.desc: Hearty beetroot soup with cabbage, potato, beans and a dollop of sour cream.
steps: Simmer the potato, carrot and cabbage in 700 ml water for 15 minutes.
Add the grated beetroot and beans and cook for 10 minutes.
Season with lemon, garlic and marjoram.
Serve with the sour cream.

meals.name: Pickle soup
meals.desc: Tangy Polish soup of grated dill pickles, potatoes and carrot.
steps: Simmer the diced potato and carrot in 600 ml water for 15 minutes.
Add the grated pickles and some brine, and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream and dill.

meals.name: Broccoli soup with feta
meals.desc: Smooth broccoli and potato soup topped with feta and seeds.
steps: Simmer the broccoli, potato and onion in 500 ml water for 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth.
Top with crumbled feta and seeds.

meals.name: Cauliflower soup
meals.desc: Polish cauliflower soup with potatoes, carrot and dill.
steps: Simmer the vegetables in 700 ml water for 20 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream and dill.
Serve with bread.

meals.name: Sweet potato and red pepper soup
meals.desc: Velvety sweet potato and roasted pepper soup with a touch of chili and coconut.
steps: Simmer the sweet potato, pepper and onion in 500 ml water for 20 minutes.
Blend with the coconut milk and chili.
Top with pumpkin seeds.

meals.name: Split pea style green pea soup
meals.desc: Bright green pea and leek soup with a dollop of yoghurt and smoked salmon ribbons.
steps: Soften the leek, add the potato, peas and 500 ml water.
Simmer for 15 minutes and blend.
Serve with yoghurt and the salmon.

meals.name: Bean and egg skillet
meals.desc: Kidney beans and eggs baked in spicy tomato sauce, Mexican-style.
steps: Soften the pepper in the oil.
Add the passata, beans, cumin and chili and simmer for 8 minutes.
Crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 6 minutes.
Serve with toasted tortilla wedges.

meals.name: Halloumi and roasted veg couscous
meals.pl: Kuskus z halloumi i pieczonymi warzywami
meals.desc: Golden halloumi on couscous with roasted pepper, zucchini and red onion.
steps: Roast the vegetables in the oil at 210 °C for 20 minutes.
Soak the couscous in 90 ml boiling water.
Dry-fry the halloumi slices for 2 minutes per side.
Serve together.

meals.name: Baked aubergine with mozzarella
meals.desc: Aubergine baked in tomato with mozzarella and parmesan, a lighter parmigiana.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Slice and brush the aubergine with oil and roast for 15 minutes.
Layer with the passata and cheeses.
Bake for 20 minutes and serve with bread.

meals.name: Potato pancakes with skyr
meals.desc: Crisp Polish placki ziemniaczane, fried in less oil and served with skyr instead of cream.
steps: Grate the potatoes and onion and squeeze out the liquid.
Mix with the egg, flour and salt.
Fry thin pancakes in the oil for 3 minutes per side.
Serve with skyr.

meals.name: Buckwheat with mushrooms and egg
meals.pl: Kasza gryczana z pieczarkami i jajkiem
meals.desc: Earthy buckwheat with fried mushrooms, onion, a soft egg and pickles.
steps: Cook the buckwheat.
Fry the mushrooms and onion in the oil.
Fry or soft-boil the eggs.
Serve with the pickles.

meals.name: Tortilla pizza
meals.desc: A crisp tortilla base with passata, mozzarella, ham and mushrooms.
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C.
Spread the passata on the tortilla.
Top with mozzarella, ham and sliced mushrooms.
Bake for 8 minutes and add rocket.

meals.name: Spinach and ricotta crepes
meals.desc: Savory crepes filled with garlicky spinach and ricotta, baked with a little cheese.
steps: Make a thin batter and fry 3 crepes.
Cook the spinach with garlic and mix with the ricotta.
Fill and roll the crepes, top with cheese.
Bake at 200 °C for 10 minutes.

meals.name: Three-bean vegetarian chili
meals.desc: Kidney beans, chickpeas and corn in a smoky tomato chili with rice and yoghurt.
steps: Soften the pepper with cumin, paprika and chili.
Add the tomatoes, beans, chickpeas and corn.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve over rice with yoghurt.

meals.name: Roast cauliflower with chickpeas and yoghurt
meals.desc: Spice-roasted cauliflower and chickpeas with garlic yoghurt and herbs.
steps: Toss the florets and chickpeas with oil, cumin, paprika and salt.
Roast at 220 °C for 25 minutes.
Serve over the garlic yoghurt with parsley.

meals.name: Mexican chicken soup
meals.desc: A spicy tomato soup with chicken, beans, corn and peppers.
steps: Brown the diced chicken and onion.
Add the pepper, tomatoes, beans, corn, chili and 400 ml water.
Simmer for 20 minutes.

meals.name: Cottage cheese with berries
meals.desc: Creamy cottage cheese with blueberries and a drizzle of honey.
steps: Top the cottage cheese with blueberries and honey.

meals.name: Chocolate skyr mousse
meals.desc: Skyr whipped with cocoa and a little honey, topped with grated dark chocolate.
steps: Whisk the skyr, cocoa and honey until smooth.
Grate the chocolate over the top.

meals.name: Greek yoghurt with honey and walnuts
meals.pl: Jogurt grecki z miodem i orzechami
meals.desc: A Greek café classic in two minutes.
steps: Drizzle the yoghurt with honey and scatter the walnuts.

meals.name: Microwave mug cheesecake
meals.desc: A two-minute protein cheesecake made from quark and egg, topped with raspberries.
steps: Mash the quark with the egg, honey and vanilla.
Microwave in a mug for 2 minutes until set.
Cool slightly and top with raspberries.

meals.name: Date and cocoa energy balls
meals.pl: Kulki mocy z daktyli i kakao
meals.desc: No-bake bites of dates, oats, peanut butter and cocoa. Makes a batch for the week.
steps: Soak the dates in hot water for 5 minutes and drain.
Blitz with the oats, peanut butter and cocoa.
Roll into small balls and chill.

meals.name: Homemade protein bars
meals.desc: Oats, whey, peanut butter and honey pressed into bars with a dark chocolate top.
steps: Mix the oats, protein powder, peanut butter and honey with a splash of milk.
Press into a lined tin.
Drizzle with melted chocolate and chill for 1 hour before cutting.

meals.name: Apple with peanut butter
meals.desc: Crisp apple slices with a spoon of peanut butter for dipping.
steps: Slice the apple and serve with the peanut butter.

meals.name: Frozen yoghurt bark
meals.desc: Greek yoghurt spread thin, scattered with berries and chocolate, then frozen and snapped.
steps: Mix the yoghurt with the honey and spread on a lined tray.
Scatter with berries and chopped chocolate.
Freeze for 2 hours and break into pieces.

meals.name: Banana nice cream
meals.desc: Frozen banana blended with skyr into soft-serve ice cream.
steps: Slice and freeze the banana ahead of time.
Blend with the skyr and cocoa until creamy.
Eat right away.

meals.name: Dark chocolate and almonds
meals.desc: Two squares of dark chocolate with a small handful of almonds.
steps: Serve together.

meals.name: Baked apple with quark
meals.desc: A cinnamon-baked apple filled with walnuts and served with sweet quark.
steps: Core the apple and fill with walnuts and cinnamon.
Bake at 190 °C for 20 minutes.
Serve with the quark mixed with honey.

meals.name: Berry compote with yoghurt
meals.desc: Warm berries simmered with a little honey, spooned over cold yoghurt.
steps: Simmer the berries with the honey for 5 minutes.
Spoon over the yoghurt.

meals.name: Banana oat muffins
meals.desc: Soft muffins made from banana, oats, egg and skyr, with no added sugar.
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C.
Mash the banana and mix with the oats, egg, skyr and baking powder.
Fold in the blueberries and spoon into 3 muffin cases.
Bake for 20 minutes.

meals.name: Rice pudding with apple
meals.desc: Polish ryż z jabłkami: creamy rice cooked in milk with cinnamon apples.
steps: Simmer the rice in the milk for 25 minutes, stirring often.
Cook the diced apple with cinnamon for 5 minutes.
Serve together with honey.

meals.name: Black bean brownie
meals.desc: Fudgy brownie squares made with beans, cocoa and egg. One square is one portion.
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C.
Blend the beans, egg, cocoa and honey until smooth.
Stir in the chopped chocolate and pour into a lined tin.
Bake for 20 minutes and cool before cutting.

meals.name: Chocolate protein shake
meals.desc: Milk, banana, cocoa and whey shaken or blended until frothy.
steps: Blend everything with a few ice cubes.

meals.name: Blueberry skyr drink
meals.desc: Skyr blended with blueberries and milk into a thick drink.
steps: Blend until smooth.

meals.name: Rice cakes with quark and radish
meals.desc: Crunchy rice cakes with chive quark and radish slices.
steps: Mix the quark with salt and chives.
Spread on the rice cakes and top with radish.

meals.name: Rice cakes with peanut butter and banana
meals.pl: Wafle z masłem orzechowym i bananem
meals.desc: A sweet, crunchy pre-workout snack.
steps: Spread the peanut butter on the rice cakes.
Top with banana slices.

meals.name: Spiced roasted chickpeas
meals.desc: Crunchy oven-roasted chickpeas with smoked paprika. Keep a jar for snacking.
steps: Dry the chickpeas well.
Toss with the oil, paprika, chili and salt.
Roast at 200 °C for 30 minutes, shaking once.

meals.name: Hummus with pitta and cucumber
meals.desc: Hummus with warm pitta strips and cucumber sticks.
steps: Warm the pitta and cut into strips.
Serve with hummus and cucumber sticks.

meals.name: Devilled eggs with yoghurt
meals.desc: Polish jajka faszerowane: yolks mashed with yoghurt, mustard and chives.
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes and cool.
Halve and mash the yolks with the yoghurt, mustard and salt.
Pipe or spoon back in and top with chives.

meals.name: Turkey roll-ups with cream cheese
meals.desc: Turkey ham rolled around light cream cheese and cucumber sticks.
steps: Spread the cream cheese on the ham slices.
Add a cucumber stick and roll up.

meals.name: Caprese with mozzarella light
meals.desc: Tomato and mozzarella slices with olive oil, pepper and rocket.
steps: Slice the tomato and mozzarella.
Layer them and drizzle with olive oil.
Season and add rocket.

meals.name: Nut and raisin mix
meals.desc: Polish mieszanka studencka: cashews, peanuts and raisins.
steps: Mix and portion into a small bag or bowl.

meals.name: Kefir with banana
meals.desc: A glass of kefir with a banana. Simple and good for the gut.
steps: Serve the kefir with the banana, or blend them together.

meals.name: Orange and almonds
meals.desc: A juicy orange with a small handful of almonds.
steps: Peel and segment the orange.
Serve with the almonds.

meals.name: Veg sticks with tzatziki
meals.desc: Crunchy carrot, pepper and celery with a garlicky Greek yoghurt dip.
steps: Grate the cucumber, squeeze it and mix into the yoghurt with garlic and salt.
Cut the vegetables into sticks.

meals.name: Smoked salmon cucumber bites
meals.desc: Cucumber rounds topped with cream cheese, smoked salmon and dill.
steps: Slice the cucumber thickly.
Top with cream cheese, a piece of salmon and dill.

meals.name: Flatbread with cheese and cucumber
meals.desc: An Icelandic snack: rye flatbread with a little butter, cheese and cucumber.
steps: Butter the flatbread thinly.
Top with cheese and cucumber.

meals.name: Half avocado with egg
meals.desc: A boiled egg and half an avocado with chili flakes and lemon.
steps: Boil the egg for 8 minutes.
Serve with the avocado, lemon, salt and chili flakes.

meals.name: Chocolate banana quark
meals.desc: Quark whipped with cocoa and topped with banana. Tastes like pudding.
steps: Whip the quark with the milk and cocoa.
Top with sliced banana.

meals.name: Chocolate chia pudding
meals.desc: Chia set in cocoa soy milk with raspberries. Vegan and filling.
steps: Whisk the chia, soy drink and cocoa.
Chill for at least 4 hours.
Top with raspberries.

meals.name: Protein waffles
meals.desc: Crisp waffles made from oats, egg, skyr and whey, with strawberries.
steps: Blend the oats into flour, then mix with the egg, skyr and protein powder.
Cook in a waffle iron for 4 minutes.
Serve with strawberries.

meals.name: Chocolate quark crepe
meals.desc: One thin crepe filled with chocolate quark and banana.
steps: Make one thin crepe.
Mix the quark with cocoa and a little honey.
Fill with the quark and banana and fold.

meals.name: Kiwi with vanilla skyr
meals.desc: Tangy kiwi over skyr sweetened with a touch of honey and vanilla.
steps: Stir the honey and vanilla into the skyr.
Top with sliced kiwi.

meals.name: Pear with ricotta and walnuts
meals.desc: Sliced pear with creamy ricotta, walnuts and a drizzle of honey.
steps: Slice the pear.
Top with ricotta, walnuts and honey.

meals.name: Cup of tomato soup
meals.desc: A warming cup of passata soup with a swirl of yoghurt.
steps: Heat the passata with 100 ml water, garlic, salt and pepper.
Swirl in the yoghurt.

meals.name: Beetroot and feta salad
meals.desc: Cooked beetroot with feta, rocket and pumpkin seeds.
steps: Slice the beetroot.
Top with rocket, crumbled feta and seeds.

meals.name: Pickles and quark plate
meals.desc: Polish dill pickles with low-fat quark and a slice of rye.
steps: Serve the pickles with the quark and bread.

meals.name: Tuna rice cakes
meals.desc: Rice cakes topped with tuna, yoghurt and cucumber.
steps: Mix the tuna with the yoghurt.
Spoon onto the rice cakes and top with cucumber.

meals.name: Mango lassi
meals.desc: Mango blended with yoghurt, a little milk and cardamom.
steps: Blend until smooth and serve cold.

meals.name: Chocolate-dipped strawberries
meals.desc: Fresh strawberries half-dipped in dark chocolate.
steps: Melt the chocolate gently.
Dip the strawberries and let them set on baking paper.

meals.name: Smoked salmon wrap
meals.desc: Smoked salmon, cream cheese, spinach and cucumber rolled in a tortilla.
steps: Spread the tortilla with the cream cheese.
Layer the salmon, spinach and cucumber.
Roll up tightly.

meals.name: Broccoli, egg and bean salad
meals.pl: Sałatka z brokułem, jajkiem i fasolą
meals.desc: A protein-rich lunchbox salad of broccoli, boiled eggs, white beans and seeds.
steps: Steam the broccoli for 4 minutes and cool.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes and quarter them.
Toss with the beans, seeds and yoghurt dressing.

meals.name: Chicken, mango and avocado salad
meals.pl: Sałatka z kurczakiem, mango i awokado
meals.desc: Grilled chicken with mango, avocado, leaves and lime.
steps: Grill or pan-fry the chicken and slice it.
Thaw and dice the mango; slice the avocado.
Toss everything with lime juice and salt.

meals.name: Polish vegetable soup
meals.desc: A gentle Polish jarzynowa with potato, carrot, cauliflower, peas and beans.
steps: Simmer all the vegetables in 700 ml water for 25 minutes.
Season and stir in the sour cream and dill.
Serve with bread.

meals.name: Egg and hummus snack box
meals.desc: A protein snack box: boiled eggs, hummus, veg sticks and rice cakes.
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes and cool.
Pack with hummus, veg sticks and rice cakes.

meals.name: Chicken couscous lunchbox
meals.pl: Lunchbox: kuskus z kurczakiem i warzywami
meals.desc: Couscous with roast chicken, roast pepper and zucchini, and a lemon dressing.
steps: Roast the vegetables at 210 °C for 15 minutes.
Pan-fry the chicken.
Soak the couscous in 90 ml boiling water.
Mix with lemon and olive oil and pack.

meals.name: Turkey, brown rice and veg lunchbox
meals.desc: A simple meal-prep box with paprika turkey, brown rice and green beans.
steps: Cook the brown rice.
Season the turkey with paprika and pan-fry for 8 minutes.
Steam the green beans.
Divide into boxes.

meals.name: Egg and avocado pitta
meals.desc: A warm pitta stuffed with sliced eggs, avocado, tomato and leaves.
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes.
Warm and open the pitta.
Fill with sliced egg, avocado, tomato and leaves.

meals.name: Tuna and egg roll
meals.desc: A wholemeal roll with tuna, egg and crunchy lettuce.
steps: Boil the egg and slice it.
Mix the tuna with the yoghurt.
Fill the roll.

meals.name: Lemon herb chicken with bulgur
meals.desc: Juicy lemon and thyme chicken with bulgur and roasted cherry tomatoes.
steps: Cook the bulgur for 12 minutes.
Pan-fry the chicken with lemon zest and thyme.
Blister the tomatoes in the same pan.
Serve with parsley and lemon juice.

meals.name: Spinach and feta stuffed chicken
meals.desc: Chicken breast filled with spinach and feta, baked and served with potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Cut a pocket in the chicken and stuff with spinach and feta.
Sear, then bake for 18 minutes.
Serve with boiled or roasted potatoes.

meals.name: Turkey skewers with tzatziki
meals.desc: Grilled turkey, pepper and onion skewers with tzatziki and pitta.
steps: Thread the turkey, pepper and onion onto skewers.
Grill or pan-fry for 10 minutes, turning.
Grate the cucumber into the yoghurt with garlic.
Serve with warm pitta.

meals.name: Beef patties with buckwheat and beetroot
meals.pl: Kotlety wołowe z kaszą i buraczkami
meals.desc: Lean beef patties with buckwheat and warm Polish beetroot.
steps: Mix the beef with grated onion, salt and pepper and shape patties.
Fry for 4 minutes per side.
Cook the buckwheat.
Warm the grated beetroot with lemon.

meals.name: Grilled pork chop with Greek salad
meals.desc: A lean pork loin steak with a Greek salad and a slice of bread.
steps: Season and grill the pork for 4 minutes per side.
Chop the tomato and cucumber and toss with olives, feta and olive oil.
Serve with the bread.

meals.name: Salmon tray bake with sweet potato
meals.pl: Łosoś pieczony z batatem i brokułem
meals.desc: One tray: salmon, sweet potato and broccoli with lemon.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Roast the sweet potato in the oil for 15 minutes.
Add the salmon and broccoli and roast 12 minutes more.
Squeeze over the lemon.

meals.name: Fish tacos with slaw
meals.desc: Spiced cod in tortillas with crunchy cabbage slaw and lime yoghurt.
steps: Season the cod with paprika and chili and pan-fry for 3 minutes per side.
Shred the cabbage and mix with lime juice and salt.
Mix the yoghurt with lime zest.
Build the tacos.

meals.name: Haddock curry
meals.desc: An Icelandic weeknight favorite: haddock in a mild coconut curry with rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the curry paste and pepper, then add the coconut milk.
Add the haddock and simmer for 6 minutes.

meals.name: Fish cakes with potato salad
meals.desc: Haddock and onion fish cakes (fiskibollur) with a dill potato salad.
steps: Blitz the fish with onion, egg, flour and salt.
Fry spoonfuls in the oil for 3 minutes per side.
Boil the potatoes, cool slightly and mix with the yoghurt and dill.

meals.name: Lentil bolognese
meals.desc: A plant-based bolognese of red lentils, carrot and tomato with wholegrain pasta.
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in the oil.
Add the lentils, passata and 200 ml water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the pasta and serve with the sauce.

meals.name: Tofu poke bowl
meals.desc: Soy-glazed tofu with rice, mango, cucumber, edamame-style peas and sesame.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the cubed tofu until golden, then toss with soy.
Build the bowl with mango, cucumber and peas.
Sprinkle with sesame.

meals.name: Egg and spinach curry
meals.desc: Boiled eggs simmered in a spiced tomato and spinach sauce with rice.
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes and peel.
Fry the onion with curry powder, add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the spinach and eggs and warm through.
Serve with rice.

meals.name: Salmon and quinoa salad
meals.desc: Quinoa with flaked baked salmon, cucumber, spinach and a lemon dressing.
steps: Cook the quinoa and cool.
Bake the salmon at 200 °C for 12 minutes and flake.
Toss everything with lemon and olive oil.

meals.name: Skyr pancakes with blueberries
meals.desc: Thick, fluffy pancakes made with skyr, served with blueberries and honey.
steps: Whisk the skyr, egg, milk, flour and baking powder.
Cook small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan for 2 minutes per side.
Serve with blueberries and honey.

meals.name: Rye crispbread with egg and salmon
meals.pl: Pieczywo chrupkie z jajkiem i łososiem
meals.desc: Rice cakes topped with sliced egg, smoked salmon and dill.
steps: Boil the egg for 9 minutes and slice.
Top the rice cakes with egg, salmon and dill.
